narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran conflict escalates with kinetic exchanges, an Apache shootdown, and a prolonged Hormuz blockade. Simultaneous Ukraine deep strikes and Israel's two-front war compound the risk premium, driving a broad selloff in equities and a flight to safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Short S&P 500 futures, long gold and US Treasuries; overweight energy equities with direct Hormuz exposure.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Oil Shock
narratives.summary: The EIA's extended blockade timeline through Q3 2026 and Kuwait's pipeline bypass discussions confirm a structural supply disruption. Oil prices are rallying as the market prices in persistent tightness, despite diplomatic noise around a potential Iran deal.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy sector ETFs; short consumer discretionary and airlines on cost pass-through.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Divergence
narratives.summary: Despite a macro-driven BTC selloff, institutional flows into crypto infrastructure continue, exemplified by Janus Henderson's tokenized CLO partnership with Ethena. This signals a bifurcation between speculative retail de-risking and long-term institutional accumulation.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate BTC on dips via spot ETFs; long ETH and select DeFi tokens with institutional partnerships.
